name: Neoptolemus II

perks.name: Agile Bowstring
perks.desc:
Durable yet light bowstring.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Tactile String
perks.desc:
Stable, high-friction bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Elastic String
perks.desc:
Excellent snapback.
  •  Decreases accuracy
  •  Faster draw time
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Flexible String
perks.desc:
Light and easy to draw.
  •  Slightly faster draw time
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: High Tension String
perks.desc:
Tightly strung bow.
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly slower draw time
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Natural String
perks.desc:
Simple balanced string.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Polymer String
perks.desc:
Unbreakable bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly faster draw time

perks.name: Carbon Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Light and stable shaft material. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Compact Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Thinner arrows to increase nocking speed and weapon handling.
  •  Increases handling speed 
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Fiberglass Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Heavy and consistent. 
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Helical Fletching
perks.desc:
Aerodynamic and light. 
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Natural Fletching
perks.desc:
Feather-light with good control.
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Greatly increases stability

perks.name: Straight Fletching
perks.desc:
Modern fletching for straight paths. 
  •  Increases accuracy

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.desc: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Sneak Bow
perks.desc: Increases hold time and reload speed, and prevents radar pings from shooting while crouched.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Ah yes. Nepotism the bow. What an interesting selection of perks. Not a single good reload perk through Rapid Hit or Archer's Tempo. You could go all 360-no-scope-Legolas-lite with Perfect Float and Air Trigger. But in reality this bow is more for ability regeneration. Pugilist or Strategist giving melee or class ability energy, respectively. Add in Wellspring for general ability energy and you've got a real quick way of getting your abilities back." Recommended MW: Accuracy ornDraw Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "It's a sad day for a weapon when To the Pain or Lone Wolf are your best bets, *and* they're in combination together. Could you make something work with it? Sure? But there are far better options. The rare Holless-IV is better than Neoptolemus II. That's saying something." Recommended MW: Accuracy or Draw Time.
